page_title: BOL 1-0 UDI | Bologna v Udinese 23/02/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Matteo Marcenaro is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+6' Idrissa Gueye (Udinese) has a crack at goal from inside the box, but the defender somehow makes the block to deny him.
90+4' The free kick is delivered by Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared.
90+3' Dangerous play by Nicolo Cambiaghi (Bologna). Matteo Marcenaro blows his whistle for a foul. Udinese have a free kick.

90+2' Excellent touch by Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese)! He latches on to an inch-perfect pass deep into the box and unleashes a low drive towards the middle of the goal. The goalkeeper reacts superbly and makes a save.
90' 6 additional min. will be played.

90' Jakub Piotrowski (Udinese) has the opportunity to threaten the opponent's goal via a free kick on the edge of the box. He hits a fine strike towards the underside of the bar, but Lukasz Skorupski denies him with a great save.
90' Handball by Remo Freuler (Bologna). Udinese will take a free kick.
85' Vincenzo Italiano has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Thijs Dallinga (Bologna) replacing Santiago Castro.
85' Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) has a chance after receiving a pass. He measures his shot from the edge of the box but it sails just wide of the left post.
84' The corner is swung in but Udinese can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
82' It is time for a substitution. Nadir Zortea (Bologna) is on for Juan Miranda.
81' The referee points to the corner flag and Udinese will take a corner.
80' Kosta Runjaic prepares a substitution. Christian Kabasele is replaced by Idrissa Gueye (Udinese).
80' We are about to witness a substitution. Oier Zarraga (Udinese) is replacing Jesper Karlstrom.

80' Juan Miranda (Bologna) must feel embarrassed now. He received a killer pass, but his shot from the six-yard box was a disaster. He miskicked and made it very easy for Maduka Okoye to get hold of the ball.
79' Jordan Zemura (Udinese) sends a cross into the box, but Lukasz Skorupski comes off his line to gather the ball.
75' 1 - 0 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Federico Bernardeschi (Bologna) into the left of the net, giving goalkeeper Maduka Okoye no chance!
75' Federico Bernardeschi (Bologna) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
75' The Bologna players are happy as the referee awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!
74' Referee Matteo Marcenaro makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Bologna. Let’s see what happens!
72' Matteo Marcenaro blows for a foul after Jesper Karlstrom (Udinese) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball. A free kick has been awarded to Bologna.
71' Here comes a substitution. Jurgen Ekkelenkamp (Udinese) is brought on as a substitute for Adam Buksa.
70' The free kick from long range, taken by Udinese, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
68' Juan Miranda (Bologna) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
67' Good team movement sets up Juan Miranda (Bologna) on the edge of the box, but he slices the ball narrowly wide of the right post.
63' Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
62' Adam Buksa (Udinese) was probably a bit loose with his words to Matteo Marcenaro, who decides to show him a yellow.
62' Some great controlled play and passing from Bologna. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
58' The referee signals a corner kick to Udinese.
56' Vincenzo Italiano has decided to substitute Riccardo Orsolini and he is replaced by Federico Bernardeschi (Bologna).
56' The game has come to an end for Jonathan Rowe. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Nicolo Cambiaghi (Bologna).
55' A substitution has been made. Tommaso Pobega goes off and Nikola Moro (Bologna) comes on.
55' Jonathan Rowe (Bologna) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked.
55' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) came close to scoring. He connected with a pass inside the box and perhaps should have done better than direct his shot straight at Maduka Okoye.
54' Jonathan Rowe (Bologna) weaves his way through opponents and strikes the ball from the edge of the area, but it's blocked by a defender.
54' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 6:2.
51' Juan Miranda (Bologna) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly towards the middle of the goal, but Maduka Okoye is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
49' Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+3' Matteo Marcenaro blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+2' Adam Buksa (Udinese) is penalised for holding. Matteo Marcenaro signals a set piece.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
45' Udinese take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
45' Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. Udinese get a corner.
44' Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety.
42' Udinese will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
42' The free kick from long range, taken by Udinese, is intercepted by one of the defenders. It will be a corner kick for Udinese.
40' Santiago Castro (Bologna) meets a cross from the flank and pulls the trigger from the edge of the box, but the ball flies high over the bar. High, wide and not at all pretty.
39' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
35' Tommaso Pobega (Bologna) receives a pass, beats an opponent and tries a long-range shot. It's a weak effort low towards the middle of the goal and Maduka Okoye easily makes the save.
34' Bologna players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.
28' Poor challenge! Juan Miranda (Bologna) is penalised for tripping and Matteo Marcenaro blows his whistle.
26' Juan Miranda (Bologna) takes the corner with a short pass.
23' The resulting corner comes to nothing as Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) sends it out of play.
22' A quickly taken corner by Bologna.
22' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked. The ball goes behind for a corner. Bologna will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
22' Corner kick. Bologna will have an opportunity.
21' Jonathan Rowe (Bologna) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. The ball is out of play and Bologna manage to earn a corner.
20' Matteo Marcenaro couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Kingsley Ehizibue (Udinese) and blew his whistle.
19' Matteo Marcenaro blows his whistle. Tommaso Pobega (Bologna) commits a foul after dangerous play.
19' Udinese hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
17' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) finds himself behind the opposition's defence, but the game is stopped for offside.
15' The referee blows his whistle, Udinese are awarded a corner kick.
15' Wow, what an escape. Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) has an effort from inside the box but it's brilliantly blocked. The ball goes out for a corner. Udinese can continue in their attacking effort.
13' Joao Mario (Bologna) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
12' Santiago Castro (Bologna) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
10' Kosta Runjaic is forced to make a change. Oumar Solet (Udinese) is unable to continue due to injury, Nicolo Bertola comes on.
8' Corner kick. Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) is ready to send the ball into the box.
6' Nicolo Zaniolo (Udinese) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked. Udinese earn a corner.
4' Oumar Solet (Udinese) commits a rough challenge and Matteo Marcenaro blows his whistle for a foul.
2' Jonathan Rowe (Bologna) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Udinese will have the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Matteo Marcenaro.
